issue.title: feat: more flexible API Client options

type.name: Feature
type.description: A request, idea, or new functionality

issue.body:
I'd like to ask for a few things:

* currently, if I delete an API Client the tokens are gone. That really sucks because they're the most tedious thing to replace. One solution here that I'd be particularly partial to is is to create token groups and then be able to apply token groups to API Clients. This would both allow mass updating of different clients' tokens *AND* would allow for easy rebuilds.
* currently, I find myself duplicating API Clients for different scenarios - localhost, staging, prod. It'd be nice if I could just have multiple tokens for the same API Client so I only have to implement the exact correct permissions structure once.
* currently, you can't duplicate an API Client token. It'd be nice to be able to do that.

issue.title: repl: add .clearhistory command

labels.name: repl
labels.description: Issues and PRs related to the REPL subsystem.

labels.name: needs-ci
labels.description: PRs that need a full CI run.

issue.body:
This pull request adds a `.clearhistory` REPL command that clears the current session history, both in memory and in the persistent history file when one is configured.

It clears the in-memory history array, resets the navigation index, and truncates the backing file through the open handle. Any pending debounced flush is cancelled first so it cannot rewrite the file after it has been cleared.

Fixes: https://github.com/nodejs/node/issues/63905

comment.body: from what I can see `.history clear` would be the only command that has two words separated by a space, which I don't think makes sense as a precedent to set.
